record.dic_text:
05829 `Ezer {ay'-zer}

與 SNH05828 同 ; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Ezer 4; 4

以謝珥/以薛/以謝 = "寶物,財富"
1) 戶沙之祖，戶珥的兒子
2) 迦得人的領袖，與大衛王一同征戰。
3) 尼希米時期一個利未人，幫助耶路撒冷城牆的修復工作
4) 以法蓮的兒子 (#代上 7:21|)
record.edic_text:
05829 `Ezer {ay'-zer}

the same as 05828;; n pr m

AV - Ezer 4; 4

Ezer = "treasure"
1) father of Hushah of the sons of Hur
2) a Gadite chief who fought with David
3) a Levite who aided in repairing the wall of Jerusalem in the time
   of Nehemiah
